title: Brucie Smash: No Banner only HULK Drops 177.86 in Week 1 and Turns the Buckaroo Football League Green With Envy
dek: Ramon's juggernaut flattened Mekhi's Dawgs by nearly 80, Zoe beat a two-time champion in her debut, Randy rode a Bears quarterback to a blowout, and the commissioner squeaked one out against the league villain.
body: Remember when Ramon got booted from this league for inactivity and his abandoned team went on a heater without him? Brucie remembers too, and apparently he spent the offseason taking notes. No Banner only HULK opened the Buckaroo Bowl IV campaign by dropping 177.86 points on Mekhi's Dawgs, who managed 98.36 and were technically favored at 54% before kickoff. Ramon's title odds rocketed from 11% to 49% in one Sunday, which means the guy who wasn't sure he even wanted to join this league is now a coin flip to win the whole thing. Everyone else in the group chat is already furious, which is exactly how Brucie likes it.

The HULK damage report reads like a highlight reel. Josh Allen threw up 35.66 points against a 19.32 projection, giving the Chicago-born Bills convert another reason to wear his turncoat proudly. Kenneth Walker III added 32.6 and D'Andre Swift chipped in 31.9, and yes, Ramon is now winning with a Bears running back while rooting for Buffalo, a betrayal on multiple levels. The most terrifying part: his Texans D/ST posted a -4, and he still won by 79.5. You can spot this team four points and it doesn't even notice.

The rookie has arrived. Zoe's Ghostu-Spider SZN took down Habibsters 129.56 to 108.6, beating the two-time Buckaroo Bowl champ in her very first fantasy game as a 48% underdog. Zilgit even left David Montgomery's 27.4 points on her bench and still won by 21, which is the kind of mistake you can only laugh off when you're 1-0. Kaushal, meanwhile, watched his title odds crater from 17% to 3% and responded by swapping out the Browns D/ST for the Jaguars D/ST, a move that suggests Habib knows he needs to speed things up, and he's no stranger to speeding.

Over in the blowout of the week, Randy's The fumblers obliterated Jordan's Counting or not Counting GV 146.16 to 75.96. Caleb Williams went off for 37.26 points against a 16.39 projection, so Randy got paid by his beloved Bears and will now refuse to trade Caleb for any price known to mankind. Derrick Henry added 34.8, more than double his projection. The only blemish was Bears tight end Colston Loveland posting a perfect zero, which Randy will surely complain about despite winning by 70. JMoney, the league's numbers guy, will not enjoy these numbers: Ashton Jeanty scored 29.7 on his bench, and his playoff odds already sit at 3%.

The tightest game of the week went to the commissioner. Sonny's The Horse is Hea edged Alan's Team Pillbert 106.42 to 102.1 as a 46% underdog, a narrow escape that the league villain will no doubt call rigged by the guy who built the website. Philliberto got 31.1 from Jahmyr Gibbs and still came up 4.32 short, so the bad guys lose round one. Strangely, Sonny's title odds actually dropped from 9% to 3% despite the win, which tells you the models saw 106 points and were not impressed. He did make a move, adding Mark Andrews and dropping T.J. Hockenson at tight end.

Rough opening week for Kai. The league's resident football brain watched Ja'Marr Chase post 2.2 points on a 16.44 projection while Christian Watson put up 29.7 from his bench. That's a 27.5-point swing in one lineup slot, and it wouldn't have been enough against the HULK anyway, but it stings. Mekhi's title odds fell from 17% to 1%, the steepest drop in the league. Still, this is the waiver-wire king we're talking about, so don't count him out until the free agent pool runs dry.

Week 2 serves up a heavyweight test for the rookie: Zoe's Ghostu-Spider SZN, fresh off her debut win, takes on Ramon's No Banner only HULK in a battle of unbeatens. Randy's The fumblers face Mekhi's Dawgs, who badly need to stop the bleeding. Alan and Kaushal meet in a 0-1 grudge match where somebody's bad luck has to end, and Jordan tries to start Jeanty this time against Sonny's The Horse is Hea. Thirteen weeks to go, four playoff spots, and one Brucie-shaped problem looming over all of it.

social.author: HULK Hogs Fan Club
social.text: 177.86. With a NEGATIVE defense. Tell us again how he should've been kicked out. Brucie is BACK and he is ANGRY. #HulkSmash

social.author: Buckaroo Insider
social.text: Sources say multiple managers have already started rage-baiting Ramon in hopes of throwing him off his game. Early returns: it's not working. Title odds 11% to 49%.

social.author: Spider SZN Stan Account
social.text: First fantasy game ever. Beat a two-time champ by 21. Left 27 points on the bench. Zilgit is just getting warmed up. Cheese curds on us this week.

social.author: Monsters of the Midway Moe
social.text: Caleb Williams 37 points for Randy. Randy will now value Caleb at approximately three first-round picks and a house. Do not even ask.

social.author: The Numbers Desk
social.text: JMoney left 29.7 points from Ashton Jeanty on the bench and lost by 70.2. Even adding Jeanty back, still a 40-point loss. Some weeks the math just says no.

social.author: Philly Truthers
social.text: Commissioner wins by 4.32 on the site he built. We're not saying anything. We're just saying.

social.author: Waiver Wire Wendy
social.text: Kai benched Christian Watson for 29.7 while Ja'Marr Chase put up 2.2. Even the smartest football guy in the league isn't safe from Week 1 chaos. Waivers should be fun this week.

social.author: Dawgs Til I Die
social.text: It's one week. ONE. We've seen this man work the wire. 17% to 1% is just a comeback narrative being set up. Stay calm. (We are not calm.)

social.author: Habib Hotline
social.text: Browns D out, Jaguars D in. Two rings on the shelf. Don't call it a slow start, call it a rolling stop. Alan, you're next.

bios.1: The commissioner escaped Alan 106.42 to 102.1 as an underdog, but the models were unmoved and dropped his title odds to 3%. Sonny swapped T.J. Hockenson for Mark Andrews and heads into a winnable date with Jordan.
bios.2: Randy rode Caleb Williams and Derrick Henry to a 146.16 to 75.96 rout, the second-highest score of the week. At 28% title odds he's a clear contender, and good luck prying a single Bear off this roster now.
bios.3: JMoney's 75.96 was the lowest score of the week, and Ashton Jeanty's 29.7 bench points made it hurt more. With 3% playoff odds after one week, Jordan needs a bounce-back against Sonny.
bios.4: Jahmyr Gibbs went for 31.1, and the league villain still lost by 4.32 to the commissioner. Philliberto sits at 0-1 with 4% title odds, which only makes a bad-guy comeback more dramatic.
bios.5: Mekhi got buried by the HULK 177.86 to 98.36 after Ja'Marr Chase posted 2.2 and Christian Watson's 29.7 sat on the bench. Title odds dropped from 17% to 1%, so it's time for the waiver-wire king to get to work.
bios.6: The two-time Buckaroo Bowl champ fell 129.56 to 108.6 to a first-year manager and watched title odds sink from 17% to 3%. Kaushal is already tinkering at defense and faces Alan in a week 2 battle of 0-1 teams.
bios.7: Ramon's juggernaut opened with a league-shaking 177.86, powered by Josh Allen, Kenneth Walker III and D'Andre Swift, and survived a -4 from its own defense without blinking. Title odds jumped from 11% to 49%, and the whole league is now rooting against Brucie, which is exactly how he likes it.
bios.8: Zoe's rookie debut was a 129.56 win over two-time champ Kaushal, and she did it with 27.4 points stuck on her bench. Next up is an unbeaten showdown with the HULK that will tell us how real this spider season is.
